description: Represents a token/variable item in the editor autocomplete.

members.name: Category
members.description: Gets or sets the optional category for grouping (e.g. "User", "System").

members.name: ColorClass
members.description: Gets or sets an optional CSS class applied to the token chip in the editor (e.g. "token-secret").

members.name: Description
members.description: Gets or sets the optional description of the token.

members.name: DisplayName
members.description: Gets or sets the display name of the token (e.g. "User Email").

members.name: Icon
members.description: Gets or sets an optional icon (emoji or CSS class) shown in the dropdown and hover preview.

members.name: Key
members.description: Gets or sets the unique key of the token (e.g. "user.email").

members.name: TypeLabel
members.description: Gets or sets an optional short type label shown in the dropdown and hover preview (e.g. "Secret").
